text: つかうのは　いわ　タイプ　ばっかりだ！

structure.jp: いわ　タイプ　ばっかりだ！

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns it into 'the thing that' or 'what', so it can be talked about. つかうのは = 'what I use is'.

patterns.name: 〜ばかり
patterns.span: いわ　タイプ　ばっかりだ
patterns.explanation: ばかり after a thing means 'nothing but' that thing. ばっかり is the stronger spoken form. いわ　タイプ　ばっかりだ = 'it's nothing but Rock types'.
